what: São Paulo city pack: heliport nodes MEASURED from the pinned days' own flight endpoints (600 m clustering across all four committed days; counts recorded per node), named where the facility is unambiguous and by district where it is not + a SIMPLIFIED corridor waypoint graph following the published REH structure (Rotas Especiais de Helicópteros, DECEA) along the Marginal Tietê and Marginal Pinheiros rivers. A PLANNING AID for the audit's counterfactual missions - never navigation, never airspace authority.

SDHE.note: busiest measured node: 45 flight endpoints across the four pinned days

bands.tiete: Marginal Tietê corridor - the REH east-west spine over the Tietê river (DECEA-published helicopter route structure; PRENOR/DCA 351-7 pinned in sources)
bands.pinheiros: Marginal Pinheiros corridor - the REH north-south spine over the Pinheiros river
bands.transition: off-river transition - ATC/CGNA coordination as required

honesty: nodes are measured flight-endpoint clusters from the committed corpora (counts stated); the graph is a hand-simplified rendering of the published REH river-corridor structure; distances are corridor path lengths over this graph; the energy verdicts on planned routes are the same certified interval decisions as everywhere else in the app, under ANAC RBAC 91.151(b)
